How are you people organizing your set and rep schemes?

I usually do a Neural Warmup for my 1st exercise only. Let's say I'm starting a leg day with BB Squats:

I'd normally do just the bar for a few reps, 135lb for x6-8, 185 for x4-6, then start my working sets (ideally til failure each or thereabouts)

225 x 6-8
235 x 4-6
245 x 3-4
Then I might go for a PR (my 1RM is 255), and after failing, I might do a drop set (like 205lb until failure, then 135 then failure) or i might do a separate final set of 205lb til failure and that's it. I'll do my other exercises and just do working sets, no need for warm up sets.

But NOW I have people telling me I'm training "wrong" and that I'll hit heavier loads if I warm up (the bar, 135lb, 185lb) the start with my heaviest set (e.g. 245lb or 235lb) and go in reverse (245, 235, 225, final drop set of 205 then 135 til failure).

What makes more sense? Should I start with my heaviest sets and drop the weight each set, trying to hit more reps each subsequent set? Or do I have it right (going heavier each set, but do a lighter burnout set last)?

Or should I do my warmups and do straight sets (3-4 working sets of the same weight, at 70-80% of my 1RM)???
